brand.name: MINIFIG // ARCHIVE
brand.aesthetic: Swiss Architectural Brutalism x High-End Collectible Minifigures
brand.vibe: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day, ultra-clean, high tension monochrome, zero rounded edges, razor-sharp precision, museum gallery presentation

fonts.display_heading: Bebas Neue, Outfit, sans-serif (Tight letter spacing, uppercase, dramatic scale)
fonts.editorial_heading: Syne, Cormorant Garamond, serif (Manifesto and chapter headings)
fonts.body_text: Outfit, Inter, sans-serif (Clean geometric sans for readability)
fonts.mono_label: JetBrains Mono, Space Mono, monospace (For specs, coordinates, prices, numbers, manifesto chapter tags)

scale.h1_hero: text-5xl sm:text-7xl lg:text-8xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight leading-none
scale.h2_section: text-3xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none

colors.rule: STRICT MONOCHROME. NO COLORS EXCEPT PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF), OBSIDIAN BLACK (#000000), AND ARCHITECTURAL GREYS (#111111, #1A1A1A, #E5E5E5, #F5F5F5). All color accents are banned.

layout_and_grid.border_radius: ZERO RADIUS EVERYWHERE. MUST USE rounded-none ON ALL BUTTONS, CARDS, INPUTS, MODALS, BADGES, AND IMAGES. No exception.
layout_and_grid.borders: 1px solid crisp borders (`border border-black dark:border-white`). Grid border exposure strategy.
layout_and_grid.spacing: Generous spacing philosophy (p-6, p-12, p-20, py-24, gap-8 to gap-16). Substantial inner padding inside containers to prevent border text collision.
layout_and_grid.bento_grid: Mode A Tetris grid for products: mix tall col-span-4 row-span-2 hero showcase, col-span-4 standard product cards, and col-span-8 wide feature spotlight frames.

kinetic_hero.description: Hero section with masked line-by-line reveal on initial load, floating 3D/parallax figure canvas preview, bold architectural typography, and ticker key-stats.
kinetic_hero.animation: Framer motion line reveal using overflow-hidden wrapper and y: ['100%', '0%'] staggered transitions.

dark_light_toggle.description: Clean, instantaneous or smooth theme switcher that toggles 'dark' class on <html> element and inverts black/white colors cleanly.

product_grid_and_spotlight.description: Curated minifigure catalog with clipped photo frames, image cross-fade/zoom hover, spotlight cursor tracker (radial light vignette), category filter bar, search input, and Quick View drawer/modal.
item_features: Add to Cart CTA with hover inversion

manifesto_chapters.description: Numbered editorial manifesto chapters (01. MATERIAL INTEGRITY, 02. ARTICULATED GEOMETRY, 03. MONOCHROME PURISM) in a 3-column sharp grid with heavy vertical dividers and hover reveal text.

editorial_marquee.description: Slow, high-density editorial ticker strip ('MINIFIG // ARCHIVE — LIMITED EDITION DROPS — 100% ARTICULATED — MONOCHROME SERIES 01 — AVAILABLE WORLDWIDE —') using custom CSS or framer-motion ticker loop.

cart_drawer.description: Slide-out sharp rectangular cart panel with quantity counter, item removal, price calculation, free shipping threshold bar, and checkout CTA.

newsletter_signup.description: High-impact footer/section email input with razor-sharp input field, submit arrow button, success notification state via Sonner toast.

motion_and_libraries.lenis_scroll: Use Lenis (@studio-freight/react-lenis or lenis) for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion_and_libraries.framer_motion: Framer motion for line reveals, scroll-triggered section entrances, modal popups, and hover state transitions.
motion_and_libraries.hover_effects: Inversion on hover: background flips from white to black (or vice versa), text flips color, subtle zoom scale (scale-105).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace default splash in App.js with the full-blown Awwwards MINIFIG // ARCHIVE shop landing page.
2. MANDATORY ZERO BORDER RADIUS: Ensure every component has class `rounded-none` or CSS `border-radius: 0 !important;`.
3. Support seamless dark/light mode toggle with theme state saved in localStorage or React state.
4. Implement the line-by-line kinetic headline reveal using Framer Motion with staggered text wrappers.
5. Include full cart state drawer, quick view modal, filtering by series/rarity, search bar, interactive spotlight hover effect, and sonner toasts.
6. Include all required test identifiers (data-testid) on navigation links, product cards, dark mode toggle, cart trigger, quick view buttons, newsletter form, and cart checkout.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and crisp 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add specific property transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons — use Lucide or Phosphor React icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations — hover states, transitions, line reveals.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
